## LEARNINGS
- Both seed elites are near-identical 6-layer attn+FFN backbones differing only in MoE width (E=2 vs E=4, k=1); the front is razor-thin (Δloss=0.013, ΔFLOPs=0.001G) — there's lots of unexplored space above/below this narrow band.
- No child has yet tested depth changes, FFN-internal sparsity, cross-depth routing, or removing modules entirely — these are the highest-value unexplored levers for extend-flops/extend-loss/novelty this generation.
- Grafting expert-compute pairs (lin+act only, re-gating downstream) is a clean way to recombine MoE capacity across elites (E=3 and E=6 variants) without dragging in the old router/slice/emul wiring.
- Plan: 3 dominate (cheap surgical tweaks), 4 extend-loss (deeper/wider capacity, crossover MoE), 4 extend-flops (strip layers/attn/FFN/MoE to find a new cheap floor), 3 fill-gap (E=3 intermediate MoE, extra attn-only layer), 3 diversify (SE-gate, dense cross-layer concat, post-norm hybrid), 3 novelty (soft mixture-of-depths gate, top-k cross-depth "hop selector", neuron-level sparse FFN).

## LEARNINGS
- Pure-backbone elite 1 (6 layers, zero MoE, 3.872@0.090G) now edges out the MoE-augmented elite 0/2 lineage at comparable FLOPs — depth+plain FFN is currently pulling more weight than sparse-MoE width, so extra layers deserve more budget this generation.
- Elite 2's post-ln `scale_shift` (0.091G, 3.840) clearly helped vs elite 0's plain MoE tail at nearly the same FLOPs — a cheap, transferable trick worth grafting onto the other lineages for dominate moves.
- Elite 3 (7 layers + MoE, 3.801@0.106G) is now the best-loss point and the biggest FLOP gap (0.091→0.106G) sits right next to it — good targets for both extend-loss (push deeper/wider) and fill-gap (partial-depth layer).
- Plan: 3 dominate (scale_shift/silu transplant onto cheaper elites), 4 extend-loss (deepen/widen elite 3 via crossover with elites 1 & 2), 4 extend-flops (strip MoE/layers from elites 0 & 1 for new cheap floors), 3 fill-gap (partial attn-only or FFN-stripped extra layers), 3 diversify (SE-gate, dense-concat router, post-norm), 3 novelty (mixture-of-depths gate, cross-depth hop selector, neuron-level sparse FFN).
